He holds a small lime-green plush doll with a black hat in his right hand. White cabinets with various items like medicine bottles and water dispensers are visible in the background setting. He carefully unclips a similar green toy from a black leather handbag resting on the table. (2) A close-up shot focuses on the man's hands as he swaps the original green plush toy with another green character toy that has pink cheeks and big eyes. The background shows blurred kitchen counters and storage containers. He performs this physical action with a slight, playful smile while his body remains stationary. (3) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a black crop top and grey high-waisted jeans, enters from the right side of the frame. She approaches the marble table, picks up the black bag with her hands, and slides a smartphone into it. She initially seems unaware of the swap as she prepares to leave the scene. (4) The woman notices the different plush toy on her bag and bursts into high-energy laughter. She points at the toy with her right hand and looks towards the camera with wide eyes. She then turns around, finds her original toy resting on a low shelf nearby, and grabs it back while continuing to laugh heartily in the domestic environment.
